mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, points_balance, cny_balance, is_deleted, create_time, update_time FROM bus_points_account WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT id, user_id, points_balance, cny_balance, is_deleted, create_time, update_time FROM bus_points_account WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bus_points_account (user_id, points_balance, cny_balance, is_deleted, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{pointsBalance}, #{cnyBalance}, 0, NOW(3), NOW(3))
mapper.update: UPDATE bus_points_account SET points_balance = #{pointsBalance}, cny_balance = #{cnyBalance}, update_time = NOW(3) WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bus_points_tx (user_id, tx_type, points_delta, cny_delta, remark, is_deleted, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{txType}, #{pointsDelta}, #{cnyDelta}, #{remark}, 0, NOW(3), NOW(3))
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, tx_type, points_delta, cny_delta, remark, is_deleted, create_time, update_time FROM bus_points_tx WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC, id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bus_recharge_order (order_no, user_id, amount, points, pay_channel, status, is_deleted, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{amount}, #{points}, #{payChannel}, #{status}, 0, NOW(3), NOW(3))
mapper.select: SELECT id, order_no, user_id, amount, points, pay_channel, status, pay_time, trade_no, is_deleted, create_time, update_time FROM bus_recharge_order WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE bus_recharge_order SET status = #{status}, trade_no = #{tradeNo}, pay_time = CASE WHEN #{status} = 1 THEN NOW() ELSE pay_time END, update_time = NOW(3) WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(points), 0) FROM bus_recharge_order WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 1 AND DATE(create_time) = CURDATE() AND is_deleted = 0

mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(points_cost), 0) FROM bus_jd_redeem WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 1 AND DATE(create_time) = CURDATE() AND is_deleted = 0

mapper.update: UPDATE bus_jd_redeem SET card_code = #{cardCode}, status = 1, admin_user_id = #{adminUserId}, fulfill_time = NOW(3), update_time = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0 AND is_deleted = 0

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bus_points_gift (sender_id, receiver_id, points, message, is_deleted, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{senderId}, #{receiverId}, #{points}, #{message}, 0, NOW(3), NOW(3))
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(points), 0) FROM bus_points_gift WHERE sender_id = #{userId} AND DATE(create_time) = CURDATE() AND is_deleted = 0

SELECT g.id, g.sender_id AS senderId, su.nick_name AS senderName, g.receiver_id AS receiverId, ru.nick_name AS receiverName, g.points, g.message, g.create_time AS createTime FROM bus_points_gift g LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON su.user_id = g.sender_id LEFT JOIN sys_user ru ON ru.user_id = g.receiver_id WHERE (g.sender_id = #{userId} OR g.receiver_id = #{userId}) AND g.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY g.create_time DESC
